description.value:
Cost 1 Vitae

Duration 1 minute

Grow claws, tusks or a barbed tail. You gain an unarmed attack with the agile and finesse traits dealing 1d6 slashing damage, using your best unarmed proficiency. That limb can hold nothing while the duration lasts.

cinderfall.incomplete: Grants a claws unarmed Strike for the duration -- an activated buff needing a Strike rule element on a companion effect, same shape as pf2e-source's own feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json (where the Strike entry lives on the companion effect, not the triggering feat). This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation.
